checks.name: Approved preference and observation compose without task or memory mutation
Both learning consent and capture permission are required
Correction invalidates old context and confirmed quiet preference suppresses guidance
A response started before forgetting cannot attach to a new learning episode
Capture revocation during image hashing fences the eventual result
Expiry, scope changes and actual task progress invalidate the composed view
Mutated request, forged completion authority and mismatched image bytes are rejected
Clear, forged tickets and old completions never resurrect or erase newer context

limits: One synthetic image/interpretation fixture; no SAM, NVIDIA or camera execution.
Browser composition only; not production identity, durable memory or measured learning.
